issues.detail: The skill does not cover all possible error scenarios and edge cases, such as handling missing environment variables or network failures.
The documentation contains extensive explanatory text that may be considered padded, reducing overall conciseness.
The installation instructions assume specific operating systems and package managers, limiting cross-platform applicability.
